subject: Civil Engineering
title: Pratt vs Warren Trusses
description: A 60-second lesson on Pratt vs Warren Trusses.

hook.text: Not all trusses look the same. The diagonal pattern changes everything.

buildup.text: A Pratt truss has diagonals sloping toward the center. They carry tension.

discovery.text: A Warren truss alternates diagonal direction — each triangle shares the work.

twist.text: Pratt trusses work best for heavy spans. Warren trusses suit lighter, even loads.

climax.text: Most highway bridges use Pratt trusses — steel diagonals in tension are efficient.

punchline.text: Same triangles, different angles, completely different strengths.

quiz.question: What direction do the diagonals slope in a Pratt truss?
options: Away from the center toward the supports
Vertically with no slope at all
